# datadog_integration_pagerduty_service_object (Resource)

Provides access to individual Service Objects of Datadog - PagerDuty integrations. Note that the Datadog - PagerDuty integration must be activated in the Datadog UI in order for this resource to be usable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datadog_integration_pagerduty_service_object" "testing_foo" {
  service_name = "testing_foo"
  service_key  = "9876543210123456789"
}

resource "datadog_integration_pagerduty_service_object" "testing_bar" {
  service_name = "testing_bar"
  service_key  = "54321098765432109876"
}

# With Terraform 1.11 or later, use the write-only attribute to keep the service key out of the state.
# Change service_key_wo_version to send a new service_key_wo value.
resource "datadog_integration_pagerduty_service_object" "testing_baz" {
  service_name           = "testing_baz"
  service_key_wo         = var.pagerduty_service_key
  service_key_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_name` (String) Your Service name in PagerDuty.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `service_key` (String, Sensitive) Your Service name associated service key in PagerDuty. This key may also be referred to as an Integration Key or Routing Key in the Pagerduty Integration [documentation](https://www.pagerduty.com/docs/guides/datadog-integration-guide/), UI, and within the [Pagerduty Provider for Terraform](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/PagerDuty/pagerduty/latest/docs/resources/service_integration#integration_key) Note: Since the Datadog API never returns service keys, it is impossible to detect [drifts](https://www.hashicorp.com/blog/detecting-and-managing-drift-with-terraform). The best way to solve a drift is to manually mark the Service Object resource with [terraform taint](https://www.terraform.io/docs/commands/taint.html) to have it destroyed and recreated. Exactly one of `service_key` or `service_key_wo` must be set.
- `service_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only service key for the PagerDuty service. The value is not stored in the Terraform state. Exactly one of `service_key` or `service_key_wo` must be set. Must be used with `service_key_wo_version`.
- `service_key_wo_version` (String) Version for `service_key_wo` rotation. Changing this triggers an update.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Pagerduty service object can be imported using the service_name, while the service_key should be passed by setting the environment variable SERVICE_KEY
# When the configuration uses service_key_wo, omit SERVICE_KEY so the key is not written to the state
SERVICE_KEY=${service_key} terraform import datadog_integration_pagerduty_service_object.foo ${service_name}
```
